name: databricks
description: Databricks skills: databricks-core (CLI, auth, profiles, ported from databricks/databricks-agent-skills) and databricks-docs (live docs.databricks.com lookups via WebFetch).

interface.longDescription: Two Databricks skills. databricks-core ports the upstream Databricks CLI / auth / profiles skill verbatim (subject to the upstream Databricks License). databricks-docs is original authorship: it points the host agent at docs.databricks.com via WebFetch, using a curated URL index, so service-specific Databricks questions can be answered from live docs instead of frozen per-service references.
defaultPrompt: Show me which databricks profile is currently configured.
